contract.boundaries: Verify timezone, daylight-saving conversions, clock precision and same-t ties. Events equal to t are not known; promise effective_at=t may apply only when observed_at<t.
contract.coverage: Separate raw valid approval denominator, joined orders, known true-event register, timestamp-valid events, and as-of covered query/history windows. Missing true-event or revision denominator means actual capture rate unknown, not 0%.
contract.decision_rule: No accepted additional as-of event/version source means pending_data_no_training. Absence within inspected sources is not global non-existence.
contract.event_rule: Require stable order identity, event type/semantics, occurred_at<t AND observed_at<t. Closure here means cancellation or another non-delivery transition that exits the risk set; existing delivery completion timestamps remain a different known event. Source received time and project persisted/ingested time must be distinguished and independently explained.
contract.joins: Verify same anonymized order_id or an authorized mapping, key uniqueness, one-to-many version cardinality, orphan events, conflicting versions and overlapping validity intervals. Seller-only linkage is insufficient.
contract.ordering: Report missing/invalid timestamps, duplicates/conflicts, event order, observed-before-occurred anomalies, late-arrival/backfill delays and immutable revision policy. A promise may be observed before its future effective time.
prohibited_substitutes: Final exported status or final single promise value
CSV mtime or later local database import/binlog time as original observed_at
Review dates or shipping deadlines as cancellation/promise revisions
A seller marketing closed-deal as an order closure
API indexed examples as acquired authorized historical same-ID data
contract.promise_rule: Require promised value, version identity, effective/valid time, observed/system time, supersession/correction/retraction history. Select only observed_at<t versions effective_at<=t and valid under what was known at t.
contract.query_clock: t is the current query approval time, not each historical order own approval. Cancellation may follow historical approval and still precede t.
contract.scope: Verify each query month and required historical lookback, including route/promise/approval-week/support coverage. Do not import future events or rescore original holdout.
contract.snapshot_alternative: Immutable complete snapshots require captured_at, available_at<t, cadence and completeness proof. They can establish known status as of a snapshot under a separately accepted contract, not exact cancellation occurrence time.

excluded_live_inputs: Live database/binlog files are not bound or reopened. Already executed read-only probe and old-binlog aggregates are bound as private evidence JSON.
specification_role: This round source snapshot and future acceptance contract; source inspection already performed. Not a model preregistration.
